messages:
maria-partnerships: NimbusEdge asked what we need for Azure Gov + GCP marketplace listing: SOC2 summary, recent pen-test, firmware attestation. Timeline ~6 weeks. Who can own intake?

sam-security: I can own SOC2 + pen ingestion. Ask for scope doc, CVSS export for highs, and remediation evidence. If pen >12mo, require retest or controls.

jon-eng: We need HSM attestation and firmware signed manifests (hashes + key fingerprint). Confirm whether pen had firmware extraction access.

lee-ops: Presign S3 upload OK. Use s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024. Default retention 30d; can extend. I'll generate a 7d presign link.

intake-bot: Created checklist MKP-5001: SOC2(sam-security), Pen(sam-security), Firmware(jon-eng), Redaction(tara-sis), Presign(lee-ops).

tara-sis: I'll provide redaction template. Ask partner to replace PII with <REDACTED_REASON> and include a redaction log.

maria-partnerships: Owners/deadlines: sam - ingest by Fri (1805700000), jon - firmware by Tue, lee - presign today, tara - redaction template by Mon. I'll send partner instructions with presign command and manifest schema.

sam-security: On receipt I'll validate scope and confirm if 3rd-party witness needed; if so ask for dates.

jon-eng: If HSM attestation required, request vendor PDF + serials and key fingerprint. We'll run verification once uploaded.

lee-ops: Presign link DM'd to partner. Please include sha256 checksum and manifest.json listing files and checksums.

maria-partnerships: Thanks team. I'll follow up with NimbusEdge and escalate if any blockers. :pray:
